name: 人物美姿重绘（转弯顺露）
description: 基于人物参考照片进行低幅度重绘，用转、弯、顺、露四类可观察变量修正姿态、手部可见性和身体线条，同时尽量保留人物身份与原始场景。
prompt_template: preserve the person's identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing identity and scene context; {subject}, {framing}, {stance}, {facing}, {bend}, {gesture}, {line_flow}, {hand_visibility}, {silhouette}, {scene_adjustment}, {lighting_adjustment}, realistic photographic retouching, natural anatomy
negative_prompt_template: {negative_prompt}, identity change, different person, age change, face reshaping, plastic skin, generic stiff pose, flat silhouette, awkward joint bends, broken limb lines, hidden hands, fused fingers, extra fingers, missing fingers, distorted anatomy, excessive background change, harsh flash, oversaturated, blurry face, watermark

defaults.subject: the same person as the reference photo
defaults.framing: keep the original framing unless full-body visibility is requested
defaults.stance: retain the original stance and improve its weight distribution
defaults.facing: turn the torso slightly away while keeping the face oriented toward the camera
defaults.bend: add one subtle bend only, such as a slight head tilt or softly bent knee
defaults.gesture: give each hand a clear resting point without inventing a complex gesture
defaults.line_flow: keep forearm-to-hand and leg-to-foot lines continuous; relax wrists and ankles
defaults.hand_visibility: make the hand location legible and keep key fingers visible without forcing every finger into view
defaults.silhouette: use a small upper-body opening and lower-body gathering without changing the person's identity
defaults.scene_adjustment: preserve the original background and make only the minimum crop or cleanup needed
defaults.lighting_adjustment: preserve the original light direction and soften distracting contrast
